mutations.name: lint:types scope skips the dependents test-scope's closure adds
mutations.find: const scope = inputs.length === 0 ? { mode: "none" } : testScope(inputs, workspace);
mutations.replace: const scope = { mode: "scoped", dirs: inputs.map((path) => path.split("/").slice(0, 2).join("/")) };
kills: lint:types scope covers a changed package and its workspace dependents, and nothing else

mutations.name: a lint:types input change stays scoped
kills: lint:types scope runs unscoped when a lint:types input or a path test-scope does not know changes

mutations.name: the coverage table drops the pnpm lint row
kills: CI_COVERAGE mirrors ci.yml matches every ci.yml run step to exactly one row and every row to a step

mutations.name: verify:changed stops planning pnpm lint
kills: CI_COVERAGE mirrors ci.yml plans every labelled row's command in ci.yml order

mutations.name: docs:build runs only behind a path trigger
kills: CI_COVERAGE mirrors ci.yml runs docs:build, capabilities:check and lint for a change no generator reads
